title: pilosella × bifurca subsp. retzensis
intro: Pilosella × bifurca subsp. retzensis, commonly known as False Sow Thistle, is a rare and endemic subspecies of the Pilosella bifurca species, belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, digestive problems, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella × bifurca subsp. retzensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
